mechanism: NSAIDs like celecoxib reduce renal potassium excretion by decreasing prostaglandin-mediated aldosterone secretion and GFR, increasing hyperkalemia risk especially in patients with renal impairment or concurrent ACE inhibitor/ARB use.
action: Monitor serum potassium levels periodically; consider potassium supplementation avoidance or dose reduction; assess renal function and use alternative analgesics if possible in high-risk patients.
